findings.title: The observed C2 cannot complete inside one provider Bash call
facts: Claude Code 2.1.306 defaults Bash to 120,000 ms (maximum 600,000 ms) unless BASH_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS / BASH_MAX_TIMEOUT_MS are set; the C2 prompt forbids a timeout field (product/worksite_command_execution.ts:2344); the transport contract sets none
the recipe commands take 230,017 ms bare at load 9.81-9.82 (prepare run), 256.3 s in dry run 2 at load 16.84; the helper adds snapshot materialization and observation of 1,119 protected files
the Product C2 budget is 855,250 ms and fits the operator limits (900,000 / 1,200,000 ms)
precedent: the longest Bash call in 201 earlier C2 transports was 57 s; the js-sdlc-bootstrap 263 s session was ttft 219,488 ms plus a ~38 s Bash call, not a 263 s Bash call
remedies: Configuration: give the provider CLI BASH_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS (and BASH_MAX_TIMEOUT_MS above 600,000 to cover the 855,250 ms budget), e.g. through provider.inheritEnvironment and the wrapper. Not verified: that a name added to provider.inheritEnvironment reaches the CLI process through the transport.
Product: the C2 transport derives the Bash call timeout from the C2 budget (the prompt or the provider lane), a code change.
findings.owner: T-287 Executive; the choice is not the Worker's

findings.title: F11 J cannot carry four candidate members inside the prompt bound (projection; no J prompt was built)
facts: J receives each material body as JSON.stringify of its text (validator/qualification.ts:589), so raw bytes are a floor; the role sources add 42674 raw bytes to every slot

over the 1,048,576-byte bound on raw bytes alone: contracts/qualification/rule-catalog.json 1,767,172; contracts/schemas/public-operation.schema.json 2,867,688; contracts/schemas/self-conformance.schema.json 1,050,028; product-toolchain-manifest.json 3,273,847 (contracts and pack members)
8 of the 28 declared surface groups exceed the bound on raw bytes; the 4 members cannot be split by any partition
D5-authored test_env/qualification/recipe/expected-output-inventory.json (879,999 bytes) fits on the raw floor; its escaped rendering was not measured
findings.consequence: A green F11 needs a code, contracts or pack change (span-carried material, or smaller published members): the activation's stop

findings.title: F11 J material floor exceeds the 40 USD cap
facts: inventory 34,531,450 bytes plus catalog sources 1,528,867 bytes read once at 4 bytes per token and 5 USD per million input tokens: 9,015,080 tokens, 45.08 USD

the six js-sdlc-bootstrap D3 transports show about 7.4 USD per million written input tokens; rule x surface pairs (95 x 28 = 2,660 in the global domain), independent peers, re-reads and output add to the floor

findings.title: No construction provenance for the pre-RC subject
facts: the candidate was constructed outside ABG; tenant and inventory attribution J requires external_construction provenance (activation, preimage, delta and closure records per chain; qualification_contracts.ts:132-140); no resource carries it

findings.title: The recipe binds the launching environment and reaches outside the C2 sandbox
facts: the configuration digests bind the ambient HOME, TMPDIR and LANG rows with LC_ALL absent; a live run launched from another environment fails as verification_recipe_configuration_mismatch
ABI5_UAT_UNIT_ROOT is written outside the C2 snapshot sandbox and outside the declared write territories (the continuation lane needs an absolute root; a relative one is refused)

ABI5_EVIDENCE_ROOT and the D3 archive inputs of the continuation lane are read outside the sandbox, unprotected by the recipe (evidence-root.mjs pins the former by digest; the lock digest pins the latter only in part)

findings.title: The inventory binds the base design, not the candidate's
facts: design differs between fd38e8227 (tree 799601bf…) and the base (d061f94b…) by one line of ABI5_COMMON_COMPUTATIONAL_CAPABILITY_LIBRARY_DESIGN.md (3d33d5584); test_env differs by D3-a, D3-a-b and D5; release-claim.md is new (99b799d56); code, contracts, scripts, package files and specification equal the candidate

findings.title: The "263 s proven" Bash figure is wrong
facts: the 263 s js-sdlc-bootstrap session was ttft 219,488 ms plus a ~38 s Bash call (09:59:51.861Z to 10:00:29.725Z)

findings.title: Qualification construction needs non-exported functions
facts: projectWorksiteCommandExecutionBudget, worksiteCommandExecutionBudgetFits, constructWorksiteCommandConfiguration, selectedWorksiteCommandAmbientEnvironment and isQualificationBasisReady are not package exports; the driver deep-imports them from the installed build

findings.title: The helper runs commands in a task-addressed snapshot sandbox
facts: worksite_command_helper.ts:596-621 materializes the protected inputs under archiveRoot/worksite-command-execution/<task>/<attempt>/sandbox, so no recipe environment value can name an absolute path inside it
